content.thinking: Hmm, /tmp might not be writable? Let me check. Actually the error says the file couldn't be created. Maybe /tmp doesn't exist in this environment. Let me use a different temp dir.

arguments.command:
ls -ld /tmp 2>&1; mkdir -p /app/work/tmp && cd /app/submission && for ex in ambiguity empty bad-type; do
  echo "=== $ex ==="
  ./run.sh < /app/examples/$ex.json > /app/work/tmp/out_$ex.json 2>/app/work/tmp/err_$ex.txt; echo "rc=$?"
  cat /app/work/tmp/out_$ex.json; echo; cat /app/work/tmp/err_$ex.txt
done
